title: BYOC on a real VPS with the daemon and terminal service shipped in Fennec.app

client.location: unknown for this run (not reported; not inferred from latency)
client.network: home LAN, route to the server through a WireGuard tunnel (utun); carrier unknown
client.daemon_under_test: Contents/MacOS/fen of a Fennec.app built with scripts/build-macos.sh (FENNEC_BUILD_DIR, signed by Fennec Local Development) from the tree of 3a028e4, copied to a temporary directory and run as control-daemon in an isolated HOME; build id 77a737d3b9cc (matches Contents/Resources/control-build-id)
client.cli_client: fen built from the same commit (a client from the bundle would register the per-user launchd job and replace the Fennec daemon running on this Mac)
client.isolation: no Runta account; USER changed so no Keychain credential is read; the installed Fennec daemon kept its pid and launchd plist

server.region_zone: asia-southeast1-b (instance metadata, captured live earlier the same day)
server.machine: n2-standard-8, Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS, x86_64, Docker 29.1.3 (shared development VM)
server.reached_at: private WireGuard address, TCP port 2223 published by Docker; address withheld
server.image: docker.io/shiqimei/fennec-cloud:1 = 1.1.0 (pulled fresh: the previous run removed it)

provenance.network_baseline: ICMP over the tunnel, 10 samples: min 5.622, avg 10.275, max 44.904, stddev 11.552 ms
provenance.other_load: the VM also ran unrelated development services; not controlled

boundaries: as in 2026-11-24-byoc-singapore-vps.json; warm operations are fen control process wall time on the Mac including CLI start, 10 sequential samples each

results.daemon_restart: pairing restored and stage ready on the first poll; the live session and its reply survived
results.unreachable_note: timed from docker stop returning; the daemon's 15 s threshold starts when the connection drops, slightly earlier

cleanup: container, volume (with the synchronized credential copy) and image removed from the server; isolated HOME, its codex credential copy and the app copy removed from the Mac; the original ~/.codex/auth.json digest was unchanged
single_run: one run, not a controlled comparison with the source-built daemon run
